edits.old: from snapshots s join staging.stg_jira__issue i on cast(i.created_at as date) between s.start_date and coalesce(s.completed_at,s.ended_at,TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-13 00:00:00+00') limit 1000
edits.new: from snapshots s join (select sp.sprint_id,i.* from s sp cross join staging.stg_jira__issue i where cast(i.created_at as date) between sp.start_date and coalesce(sp.completed_at,sp.ended_at,TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-13 00:00:00+00') limit 1000) i on s.sprint_id=i.sprint_id
avg(prev_remaining-remaining) over(partition by sprint_id order by day_number rows between 2 preceding and current row) velocity_trend_3d

edits.old: case when coalesce(prev_remaining-remaining,0)>5 then 'High Velocity' when coalesce(prev_remaining-remaining,0)>2 then 'Good Velocity' when coalesce(prev_remaining-remaining,0)>0 then 'Low Velocity' when coalesce(prev_remaining-remaining,0)=0 then 'No Progress' else 'Negative Velocity' end
edits.new: case when prev_remaining-remaining>5 then 'High Velocity' when prev_remaining-remaining>2 then 'Good Velocity' when prev_remaining-remaining>0 then 'Low Velocity' when prev_remaining-remaining=0 then 'No Progress' else 'Negative Velocity' end
